newsitem.title: FRANCE: AB Sat launches digital TV service today.
newsitem.headline: AB Sat launches digital TV service today.

text.p: AB Sat said it would start selling subscriptions to its digital satellite television service from midnight in competition with Canal Satellite and TPS, a spokeswoman for the company said.
For the first six months, the basic AB digital service will be free, instead of 49 francs per month, while the offer of basic services plus cinema will be 80 francs instead of 129.
The TPS service of TF1, Lyonnaise des Eaux , CLT, M6, France Television and France Telecom started on December 16 and Canal Plus's Canalsatellite on April 27.
